text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #555c66

g.text: Bands and bars show descriptive variation across clean prompts (±1 sample SD); corrupted controls can repeat. Layers are zero-based.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #555c66

g.text: Node patches replace clean MLP outputs during corrupt inference. Direct readout replaces only MLP 10's contribution to the clean final residual.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #555c66

g.text: Paired effects: node recovery = (PD − corrupt PD) / (clean PD − corrupt PD); direct Δ clean = PD − clean PD. Numeric probabilities are never renormalized.
